items.title: Branford Marsalis — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: You know I played with them three or four times and never got paid for the shit.

ctx.x: Un-Huh. So, they said, “Oh, let’s play “Dark Star.” “OK.” “Oh, we take it out, OK. We go into space. We do all this stuff.” I’m like, “OK, yeah.” And, they started playing the song and the roar from the crowd was like…(inaudible gesture), you know? And, later on, when Deadheads started calling me on my private number, I’d say, “How did you get this number?” “Don’t worry man, we’re harmless, but we’re everywhere. He called and said, “Thank you, man. They haven’t played ‘Dark Star’ in six months.” They’d be…
I’d call them up. I’m in town where they are. I say, “Hey, you guys want a sax player.” They say, “Yeah, c’mon through.” It was fun. I had a good time.
